items.title: Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
items.body: September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month over month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.

items.title: Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done
items.body: 'We see real risks the Fed will deliver another rate hike in two weeks' time,' one Fedwatcher warns

items.title: U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting
items.body: The exchange comes as U.S. debt exceeds $40 trillion and 10-year Treasury yields remain above 5%, intensifying scrutiny of the fiscal outlook.

items.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
items.body: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

items.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
items.body: France opens debate on its 2027 budget as high deficits, rising debt and student protests intensify pressure on lawmakers.

items.title: China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration
items.body: European trade commissioner Maroš Sefčovič met with Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao in Beijing last week.

items.title: UK economy grew 0.1% in August, beating expectations
items.body: The U.K. is grappling with a cost-of-living crisis sparked by sticky inflation and surging energy costs.

items.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
items.body: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.
